business_summary: Grinm Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of advanced materials in China and internationally. The company offers Cu and Cu, and Al and Al alloy series; Ti and Ti Coil; W, WTi, Ta, and Ta Coil; Co, Au, Ag, NiPt, NiV, AlSc, CuP, and other metals; Ni, Pt, Sn, Cr, and other basic full-size evaporation pellets and cone; and gold tin solder pads, gold germanium solder pads, and gold tin solder paste. It also provides gold, platinum, palladium, rhodium, iridium, ruthenium, silver, and silver-palladium alloy powders; platinum, gold, silver, silver palladium, and ruthenium paste; platinum tungsten alloy ultrafine, platinum nickel alloy ultrafine, and platinum iridium alloy ultrafine wires; nonferrous metals; and high purity-rare earth oxides, such as high-purity lanthanum, high-purity neodymium, and high-purity ytterbium oxide. In addition, the company offers rare earth permanent magnet, giant magnetostriction materials, and magnetic refrigerant materials; rare earth luminescent materials; rare earth metal and alloy; infrared optical material; infrared optics; middle wave lens 3-5µm, Long wave cooled and uncooled infrared lens 8-12µm; low dislocation germanium monocrystal; digital orthodontic and fixed orthodontic products; nickel-titanium materials; orthopaedic instruments; and precious metal compounds. Further, it provides rare earth technology consulting services for the government, enterprises and universities. Grinm Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is based in Beijing, China.
